source.prompt: Premium hand-painted arcane energy crest tokens, designed for a readable 64px actor HUD. Fire: scarlet/orange angular combustion crest; Ice: cyan/white crystalline frost crest; Air: turquoise vortex crest; Earth: ochre/emerald fractured geomantic crest; Light: gold/white vertical radiant prism, never a sun or star; Dark: violet/indigo fractured void rift, never a moon or crescent. Transparent background, no text.

normalization.crop: per-element alpha bounds, expanded 14% to preserve the energy silhouette

variants.64: root PNG files; Unity runtime source
